description: Land Acquisition - Gonawala, Kundasale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and location details) that are being acquired for public purposes. The content focuses solely on land matters, including claimant information and compensation procedures, without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other category. This fits precisely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
